description: This file contains utility functions and classes for the Education module in an LMS system, including overlap validation, student enrollment, progress tracking, and quiz management.

classes.name: OverlapError
classes.description: Custom validation error class for overlap validation.

methods.name: validate_overlap_for
methods.description: Checks for overlapping schedule times for a given document and field.

methods.name: get_overlap_for
methods.description: Retrieves overlapping schedule entries for a specific field and document.

methods.name: validate_duplicate_student
methods.description: Validates that students are not duplicated in a list.

methods.name: get_current_student
methods.description: Returns the current logged-in student based on session user.

methods.name: get_portal_programs
methods.description: Fetches programs to display on the portal based on publication and enrollment status.

methods.name: allowed_program_access
methods.description: Checks if the current user has access to a specific program.

methods.name: get_enrollment
methods.description: Retrieves enrollment record for a student in a program or course.

methods.name: enroll_in_program
methods.description: Enrolls the current or specified student into a program.

methods.name: has_super_access
methods.description: Determines if the current user has full access roles.

methods.name: add_activity
methods.description: Adds an activity (e.g., quiz, content) for the current student in a course.

methods.name: evaluate_quiz
methods.description: Evaluates a quiz response and records the attempt.

methods.name: get_quiz
methods.description: Fetches quiz questions and status for a student.

methods.name: get_topic_progress
methods.description: Returns progress status for a specific topic within a course.

methods.name: get_course_progress
methods.description: Returns overall progress for a course.

methods.name: get_program_progress
methods.description: Returns progress for a program based on its courses.

methods.name: get_program_completion
methods.description: Calculates overall completion percentage for a program.

methods.name: create_student_from_current_user
methods.description: Creates a new Student record from the current user session.

methods.name: get_or_create_course_enrollment
methods.description: Retrieves or creates a course enrollment for the current student.

methods.name: check_content_completion
methods.description: Checks if a specific content item has been completed by the student.

methods.name: check_quiz_completion
methods.description: Checks attempts and status for a quiz for a student.
